nativeLayoutOracle: Expected context layout copied from the frozen ABI v3 contract and to be checked against src/AgentLang.Llvm/native/runtime_test.c --layout-json; values are independent of the managed ABI declarations.

inputContract.inputOwner: read-only retained arena descriptor; may be null when no RetainedRoot argument is selected
inputContract.inputRoots: ordered invocation values resolved from RetainedRoot selections and primitive message arguments; not the owner's full root table
inputContract.inputRootTypeIds: zero-based program type IDs for the ordered invocation values
inputContract.inputRootCount: number of ordered invocation slots and type IDs
inputContract.import: copy and validate the entire input owner's immutable graph before executing the entry body; preserve source owner bytes and metadata

preconditions: context is at least 96 bytes aligned to 8 bytes
status is initialized by the raw caller before invocation
the ABI version is validated before reading the ABI v3 tail at offsets 64 through 92
input owner spans are read-only and do not overlap writable scratch, retained, workspace, outputs, context, or status spans
input root slots and type IDs contain exactly inputRootCount ordered invocation values
